# deps: tools: remove git-vertag

Remove `git-vertag` ([[DOT-366]]) from the Go toolset. **Motivation:** no reaction to [kyoh86/git-vertag#14](https://github.com/kyoh86/git-vertag/issues/14), the request for a Go-module-compatible `v2` path; without it the tool could only be pinned to an old pseudo-version ([[DOT-379]], [[DOT-384]]), which violated the toolset's "tagged releases only" rule ([[DOT-382]]).
